profile: Forward Air provides asset-light transportation and logistics services across North and South America, Europe, and Asia. Its offerings include expedited less-than-truckload transportation, pickup and delivery, truckload, air and ocean freight forwarding, fulfillment, customs brokerage, warehousing, distribution, and intermodal container drayage. Customers include businesses shipping time-sensitive freight, including companies in technology, retail, media, life sciences, and e-commerce.
